title: Registration number
description: Waste carrier, broker or dealer registration number, in a valid UK home-nation format (England and NRW CBDU/CBDL, SEPA WCR/SCO/SEA/SNO/SWE and PCT, NI ROC UT/LT). Mirrors ALL_CARRIER_REGISTRATION_NUMBER_REGEXES from @defra/waste-movement-utils, as one case-insensitive pattern; unlike Phase 1 it also allows surrounding whitespace.
